oreui.preview.demo.title: OreUI Lib / Standalone player previews
oreui.preview.demo.description: Native models with supplied textures. No world or player needed.
oreui.test.presets.body: Grid regions keep the header/footer fixed while the body scrolls. These values are local examples.
oreui.test.presets.local: Local UI only; no settings are saved.
oreui.test.presets.applied: Example applied locally. No configuration was changed.
oreui.hud.demo.title: Ore UI / Persistent HUD
oreui.hud.demo.hint: F7: cursor mode. Escape: exit. Remap the key in Controls.
oreui.test.title: Ore UI / Test Lab
oreui.test.subtitle: Tab to navigate. Escape to close. Scroll for more.
oreui.test.ready: Choose an element family in the navigation bar.
oreui.test.buttons.description: Five palettes, centered icon/text content, and button states.
oreui.test.button.tooltip: Mouse click, Enter, or Space. One activation per press.
oreui.test.selection.description: Checkboxes, radio groups, switches, sliders, and dropdowns.
oreui.test.text.description: Native editing, live search, numeric validation, and key bindings.
oreui.test.text.label: Preview text
oreui.test.search.label: Search materials
oreui.test.number.label: Numeric input
oreui.test.text.description.field: Native text editing, selection and clipboard.
oreui.test.search.description.field: Filters the materials below as you type.
oreui.test.number.description.field: Enter or loss of focus commits a finite number.
oreui.test.keybind: Bind a key or mouse button
oreui.test.keybind.changed: Binding changed to %s. Gameplay bindings are unchanged.
oreui.test.colors.description: Inline RGB pickers: drag to choose saturation/brightness, adjust hue, or enter hex. Changes apply immediately; no popup.
oreui.test.color.resource.note: The picker edits a local UI value only. No configuration or network state is changed.
oreui.test.feedback.description: Status, progress, motion, tooltips, and notifications.
oreui.test.label.example: A plain, wrapping Component label without a text shadow.
oreui.test.toast.title: Ore UI notification
oreui.test.tooltip: Hover or focus for a tooltip
oreui.test.tooltip.body: This uses Minecraft's native tooltip and narration facilities.
oreui.table.summary: %s rows. Column: %s. Left/Right chooses a column; Enter or Space sorts.
oreui.test.banner.info: Information banner: values survive navigation and resizing.
oreui.test.banner.warning: Warning banner: this gallery is a UI test, not a complete implementation of every design variant.
oreui.test.card.title: Action card
oreui.test.card.body: A reusable card with a title, wrapping body, accent, visible focus, and an ordinary button callback.
oreui.test.card.second.title: Open a popup
oreui.test.card.second.body: This card opens a real input-blocking popup. Escape dismisses it before the gallery.
oreui.test.card.image.title: Creative world
oreui.test.card.action.clicked: The independent card footer action was activated.
oreui.test.card.image.note: Card imagery is application supplied. These examples use Minecraft's stone texture instead of copying the reference project's world screenshot.
oreui.test.structures.description: Expandable accordions, sortable tables and interactive scrollbars from the new community reference.
oreui.test.accordion.body: Click the header or press Enter or Space to expand and collapse the text. The owning screen relayouts its content and updates the scrollbar. No game or network state is changed.
oreui.test.table.title: Inventory example
oreui.test.table.name: Name
oreui.test.table.note: Click a header to sort. With keyboard focus, Left/Right chooses a column and Enter/Space changes sorting. Count uses numeric ordering.
oreui.test.scrollbar.note: Drag the thumb or click the track. Focus enables arrows, Page Up/Down and Home/End. The gallery and popup vertical scrollbars use the same control.
oreui.test.icons.pixel.note: Your loading and progress strips use 16 native 15x15 frames. The spinner loops every 1.6 seconds; progress runs from empty at 0% to a full ring at 100%.
oreui.test.media.description: Browse all 59 cleaned pixel icons, native/enlarged previews, and your loading/progress animation strips.
oreui.test.icon.dimensions: %s: %s x %s canvas, %s x %s painted pixels. Both previews keep an integer pixel scale.
oreui.test.texture.note: minecraft:textures/block/stone.png is supplied by Minecraft, not copied into this mod.
oreui.preview.player.unavailable: Enter a world to preview a player
oreui.test.models.description: Native item, block-state and player models. All transforms and animations affect only the previews.
oreui.test.models.floating: Float and rotate like a dropped item
oreui.test.models.move: Move the model inside its preview
oreui.test.models.item.note: Item models keep their native geometry: a flat sprite does not become a full 3D mesh. Nothing is spawned in the world.
oreui.test.models.gear.unavailable: Enter a world before copying equipment.
oreui.test.models.gear.vanilla: Vanilla gear copied. Curios is not installed or its inventory is unavailable.
oreui.test.models.gear.curios: Curios snapshot: %s equipped and %s cosmetic slots (including hidden items).
oreui.test.models.use: Use the held item (bow, food or crossbow)
oreui.test.models.look: Follow the mouse with the head
oreui.test.models.player.note: Starts with your armor, hands and optional Curios accessories. Refresh to copy changes; cosmetic items and visibility are preserved. Demo loadouts replace only the preview's hands with an item and shield. Select a bow, apple or crossbow before pressing Use. Your inventory stays unchanged.
oreui.test.navigation.description: Tabs, pagination, popups, confirmations, and nested menus.
oreui.test.tab.content: Content for tab %s. Tab selection survives leaving this page.
oreui.test.modal.body: A community-style modal with a compact back/title/close header, labeled input and a fixed confirmation/action area.
oreui.test.modal.field.description: This value is local to the demo.
oreui.test.popup.body: This is a real topmost UI layer. It owns input and keyboard focus until dismissed. The gallery underneath retains its state.
oreui.test.confirm.body: Confirm this local demo action? Nothing is deleted or sent to a server.
oreui.test.slider.label: Progress
oreui.keybind.prompt: Press a key or click a mouse button. Escape cancels; Backspace clears the binding. This does not change Minecraft's gameplay key mappings.
oreui.color.square.usage: Drag to choose a color. Left/Right adjusts saturation; Up/Down adjusts brightness. Hold Shift for larger steps.
oreui.color.hue.usage: Drag or use arrow keys to adjust hue. Hold Shift for larger steps. Home/End selects either end of the spectrum.
